events.name: IDEATEK
events.description: The premier 2-day flagship Ideathon: Build disruptive technology solutions for tomorrow's grand challenges.
rules: Participants are responsible for the safety of their laptops, mobile phones and other personal belongings.
Participants are strictly prohibited from preparing or bringing pre-made presentations.
Problem statements will be announced by the college during the event.
All presentations must be prepared only after the official announcement of the problem statements.
Food and refreshments will be provided by the college.
Team of 2 to 4 members with valid college ID cards.
Overnight 24-hour innovation and prototype sprint (Dec 2–3, 2026).

sections.title: 1. Mandatory Items
items: College ID card or valid student ID
Hardware components required for the prototype

sections.title: 2. Personal Essentials
items: Soap, face wash and other toiletries
Comfortable clothing for the overnight stay

sections.title: 3. Overnight Stay Essentials
items: Other personal sleeping essentials, if required

sections.title: 4. Important Instructions
items: Participants are responsible for the safety of their laptops, mobile phones and other personal belongings.
Participants are strictly prohibited from preparing or bringing pre-made presentations.
Problem statements will be announced by the college during the event.
All presentations must be prepared only after the official announcement of the problem statements.
Food and refreshments will be provided by the college.

guidelinesAndChecklist.importantReminder: Please ensure that you carry all the necessary items for a comfortable and productive 24-hour event. Be prepared. Be creative. Be innovative!

events.name: BUG SLAYER
events.description: Enter the neon simulation to hunt, isolate, and eradicate code vulnerabilities against the clock.
rules: Individual participation only.
Participants must bring college ID card.
Programming languages supported: C, C++, Java, Python.
Round 1: Rapid syntax & logic debugging (30 mins).
Round 2: Algorithmic fix and performance optimization (45 mins).
Decision of the judges and coordinators is final.

events.name: MIRROR MASTER
events.description: Recreate a high-fidelity cyberpunk web interface with pixel perfection and dynamic responsiveness.
rules: Team of 1 to 2 members.
Target website mockup will be revealed at the commencement of the event.
Allowed stack: HTML5, CSS3/Tailwind, Vanilla JS or React.
No external pre-built templates or AI generators allowed.
Submissions evaluated on visual fidelity, responsive fluidity, and clean semantics.

events.name: FOTONOVA
events.description: Capture the pulse, light, and cyberpunk festival moments across the campus through your creative lens.
rules: Individual participation only.
Theme will be announced at the commencement of the event.
All photos must be taken inside the campus during festival hours.
Basic color grading and cropping permitted; AI generative modification prohibited.
Participants must submit raw EXIF metadata alongside final entries.
Judging criteria: Composition, Storytelling, Lighting, and Thematic Impact.

events.name: TEKNOVA E-CLASH
events.description: Command the virtual pitch in an electrifying knockout e-football tournament.
rules: Solo 1v1 console/PC tournament.
Match duration: 10 minutes regular time.
Knockout format; extra time and penalties if tied.
Controllers will be provided, but participants may bring personal certified controllers.

events.name: TEK ROYAL
events.description: Drop into the battleground with your squad. Strategy, precision, and survival till the last zone.
rules: Squad participation (strictly 4 players).
Mobile devices only (no emulators, triggers, or tablet displays).
Matches will be hosted on custom rooms.
Points system: Placement points + Kill points as per official tournament standards.

events.name: FIND-X
events.description: Decrypt cryptic riddles, scour hidden campus coordinates, and race against rival squads to uncover the ultimate digital-physical artifact.
rules: Team of 3 to 4 members.
Teams will receive cryptographic and physical clues leading across campus coordinates.
All clues must be solved sequentially; skipping checkpoints leads to disqualification.
Use of electronic navigation and campus maps permitted.
First team to unearth the final artifact and report to the central base wins.

events.name: TEKTONIQ
events.description: High-octane technical quiz testing your depth in computing history, algorithms, cryptography, and modern AI.
rules: Teams of 2 members.
Preliminary written round for all registered teams.
Top 6 teams qualify for the buzzer stage round on main stage.
Negative marking applies in final rounds.
